summary: No held thesis was broken by news today. The market-moving stories were macro (Fed hold with two hike dissents, 82% December hike odds on Polymarket, 10-year near 5%, Q3 GDP +3.4% and September PCE 3.6% in line) and Alphabet's roughly 11% premarket drop on a search slowdown, which touches QQQ-style exposure but not the book (VOO and VTI were down 0.6% to 0.9% on the day while the single stocks rose 1% to 4%). CART was the one confirmed event: DoorDash agreed to buy Instacart at $65 per share (about $17B, at least 75% cash, 8-K 1.01 filed today); CART is not held, so it only validates the 10-27 merger-arb flag and the PM's choice to stay out. Held-name news was light: FTC information request on personalized pricing and wage setting named WMT (10-28, 8-K-free, a sector-wide inquiry, low risk), a law-firm derivative-claim solicitation on DPZ after a securities class action survived a motion to dismiss (plaintiff-firm marketing, but a real litigation overhang), and a PBM transparency rule that hits CVS, not held. BTC/USD slipped back to about $80,000 after the Fed hold with bearish commentary (Cowen, hot-PCE selloff risk) offset by constructive items (Glassnode, CLARITY Act and reserve talk); no exchange failure or adverse regulatory action, so the BTC thesis invalidation (a 10% close below the $83.7k fill, about $75.3k, or an exchange/regulatory event) has not tripped. Today was a continuation of the 10-26 and 10-27 macro and AI-capex threads, not a new shock.
upcoming: Event risk for held names: IDXX estimated earnings 11-02 (2 trading days, approximate, last year's date + 364; high risk for any add; it is 6.8% of equity at beta 0.81, and UBS cut its PT to $627 on 10-27, a second cut after Jefferies on 10-20, so the PT drift into the print is negative). CARG estimated 11-05 (5 trading days, at the edge of the window, 5.1% of equity, no negative headlines). Nothing else held reports within 5 trading days: WMT ~11-19 (the 10-23 8-K item 8.01 is still unread, probably routine; this is the open L2 item, and the FTC inquiry is a new low-level headline), KR 12-03, FAST 2027-01-19, MSM 2027-01-06, MSCI 2027-01-27, VRSN 2027-02-04, DPZ 2027-02-22. CLX (not held) estimated 11-02 with a 5.02/7.01 8-K today for the CEO change (Fabian Garcia from 1-5-2027) on top of negative sell-side drift. Macro: PCE follow-through and the Fed path (December hike odds 82%) for BND, IEF and the 10-year near 5%; mega-cap earnings (Microsoft and Amazon reaction, Apple results still pending and its 10-29 estimate disputed vs 11-02) and oil/Iran for VOO, VTI and QQQ; Strategy's report 10-29 and the midterms for BTC. L1 follow-up: DPZ's invalidation of $274.88 is still anchored to the $305.42 reference close and sits about 13% below the $316.58 fill (position now -1.0%); re-anchor it. Flags that came to nothing: the estimated 10-28/10-29 earnings dates for GRMN, CVS, HWM and BDC all resolved from filings or headlines (GRMN, HWM, LNG, BDC, INCY have reported; CVS and CALX still show no results in the inputs), and the 10-27 CART takeover flag came true.
